brief: The stealth slice: rooftop stealth and parkour in the manner of Assassin's Creed and Metal Gear, at dusk in an old town. A hooded assassin (a person of unknown sex, never named) steals a ledger (an account book) from a brick roof and slips out by the east gate past three patrolling guards. Nobody speaks: its words are an objective with a distance, a status, key hints, short notices and the results, plain and quiet in tone.
